answer: A farm of 37 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in pigment, queued in beacon, and mesa publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 25 identities per epoch. A farm of 4908 identities would post 1843 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
